mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_id, third_category_id, description, price, stock, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM product
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, category_id = #{categoryId}, third_category_id = #{thirdCategoryId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_id, third_category_id, description, price, stock, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT id, name, category_id, third_category_id, description, price, stock, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT id, name, category_id, third_category_id, description, price, stock, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM product WHERE MATCH(name) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category_id, p.third_category_id, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS sales FROM product p LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY sales DESC, p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
